title: Mountain Height Changes With The Starting Point
hook: Mauna Kea measures 10,211 meters from base to summit.
closing: Earth's highest mountain changes when you change where the measurement begins.
question: Which definition of mountain height makes the most sense?

segments.say: Everest stands 8,849 meters above sea level, the familiar measure behind its title.
Mauna Kea reaches 10,211 meters from base to summit, overtaking Everest by another measure.
Chimborazo sits 13.4 kilometers farther from Earth's center, making its summit closest to space.
